passages.text: La entrada general son doce euros. Los menores de dieciocho entran gratis, y los domingos por la mañana la entrada es libre para todos. La audioguía cuesta tres euros más y la puede descargar en el móvil.
passages.en: General admission is twelve euros. Under-eighteens go free, and on Sunday mornings entry is free for everyone. The audio guide is three euros extra, and you can download it on your phone.
passages.question: When can everyone get in for free?

passages.text: O bilhete normal custa doze euros. Os menores de dezoito anos não pagam e ao domingo de manhã a entrada é livre para todos. O audioguia custa mais três euros e pode descarregá-lo no telemóvel.
passages.en: General admission is twelve euros. Under-eighteens go free, and on Sunday mornings entry is free for everyone. The audio guide is three euros extra, and you can download it on your phone.
passages.question: When can everyone get in for free?

passages.text: La exposición temporal está en la segunda planta, pero el ascensor está averiado, así que tendrá que subir por la escalera del fondo. Fotos sí, pero sin flash.
passages.en: The temporary exhibition is on the second floor, but the lift is broken, so you'll have to take the stairs at the back. Photos are fine, but no flash.
passages.question: How do you get to the exhibition?
passages.answer: Take the stairs at the back; the lift is broken.
wrong: Take the lift to the second floor.

passages.text: Este palacio se construyó en el siglo dieciséis para una familia de comerciantes. Lo que ven en el techo es original; los muebles, en cambio, son copias, porque los auténticos se perdieron en un incendio.
passages.en: This palace was built in the sixteenth century for a family of merchants. What you see on the ceiling is original; the furniture, on the other hand, is a copy, because the real pieces were lost in a fire.
passages.question: What is original?

passages.text: Este palácio foi construído no século dezasseis para uma família de comerciantes. O que veem no teto é original; os móveis, pelo contrário, são cópias, porque os verdadeiros se perderam num incêndio.
passages.en: This palace was built in the sixteenth century for a family of merchants. What you see on the ceiling is original; the furniture, on the other hand, is a copy, because the real pieces were lost in a fire.

passages.text: Con la entrada de hoy puede salir y volver a entrar una vez; solo tiene que enseñarla en la puerta. La cafetería cierra media hora antes que el museo, a las cinco y media.
passages.en: With today's ticket you can leave and come back in once; just show it at the door. The café closes half an hour before the museum, at half past five.
passages.question: When does the museum close?
